notes.title: TEMPLES & SKILLS UPDATE
notes.content:
Temple Ruins
In each location there are temple ruins that you can rebuild. 
When you do it - you get a skill that stays with you to the end of the game.

In addition, a lot of amenities, new mechanics and sounds...

Skills:

TURBO
SHIFT + MAIN ENGINE = GREAT ENGINE POWER. INCREASES FUEL CONSUMPTION.

SHIELD
THE SHIP'S HULL IS STRONGER.

LASER
CTRL DEPLOY SHIP'S LASER CANNON. LASER CANON RECHARGES UP TO SIX SHOTS.

FUEL
SHIP ENGINES USE FUEL SLOWER.

HYPNOSIS
THERE ARE MORE SPECIAL ITEMS TO TRADE IN THE VILLAGES.

ROTATION
THE SHIP'S ROTARY ENGINES ARE MORE POWERFUL.

URANIUM
SCANNERS FIND URANIUM ORE FOR NUCLEAR REACTORS.

SUCKER
YOU CAN PICK FRUITS WITHOUT LEAVING THE SHIP ( ENTER WHEN SHIP IN FIELD ).

DRILLER
THE MINERALS DRILL IS STRONGER

BATTERIES
BATTERIES IN REPAIRED MACHINES LAST LONGER

DISTILLERS
DISTILLATORS WORK FASTER. THEY USE A LITTLE MORE ENERGY.

TRADER CALL
WHEN THE RADIO IS RECHARGED - YOU CAN CALL THE TRADER WHEN YOU WANT.



Little Changes:
- More pixel fonts,
- shortened scanner operation time,
- Improved smoke and steam stills,
- New time control icons,
- Improved elements of the top bar,
- Improved graphics of the pilot's work,
- Reduced prices of nuclear reactors,
- Decreased Rocket Launcher prices,
- Killed turkeys respawn faster,
- Changed mouse graphics,
- Changed ship repair smoke,
- The function of automatic refueling of the cosmodrome tank,
- Items fall off the ship when unloading,
- Multi-line info screen - lots of information at once
- New sounds (radio, skills),
- Higher spaceport fuel tank,
- The pilot has a working animation
- The ship has a heating nozzle,
- The ship has position lights,
- Flying birds (environment),
- Moving Clouds (environment).

notes.title: Temple Ruins
notes.content:
I'm working on a big update. 

There will be temple ruins in each location. You can rebuild them. 
When you do - you get a new skill that enriches the game.

Skills:

- Turbo speed of the ship (shift while in flight speeds up the ship),
- Better ship hull (the ship withstands more hits),
- Ship Laser (destroys flying targets),
- Reduced fuel consumption,
- Village hypnosis module (more special items for trade),
- Faster turning of the ship (more powerful side engines),
- Ability to mine uranium (charging nuclear reactors),
- Automatic fruit loader (possibility to load fruit without leaving the ship),
- More powerful mineral drill bit,
- Super batteries for repaired machines,
- Faster work of stills,
- Trader beacon (allows you to summon a trader).

notes.title: Version 0.94.2
notes.content:
- Save bug fixed,
- Added new fonts.

notes.title: January Update
notes.content:
Rocket Launchers possible to build in the base
There are rocket launchers in the list of buildings. They work fully automatically. They consume some energy when charging. But you can turn them off.


Pilot picks up items
Small items picked up by the pilot are picked up (previously they just disappeared). A small thing, but it makes me happy.


The ship's engine has smoke
Now smoke comes out of the engine with the fire. It reflects off the surface of the world - that's what I've always missed.


Fireflies are more dangerous
Now that we have rocket launchers, fighting the fireflies has become easy... so they have to be a little more dangerous.


Ship repair aid added to the ship
Now when we want to repair the ship in the field - we have a visible message above the ship.


Key animation bug in main menu fixed
Button animations in the main menu go back to the beginning when the mouse leaves them.

notes.title: See what I'm working on...
notes.content:
DevLog #1: Nuclear Reactors.

Playing with batteries and charging them is fun. But sometimes I missed something that would take up less space in the base and give a lot of energy...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197634/9bfd8a7b35ff5a0025367e24f391d644a2433a0f.gif

You can now build nuclear reactors (there are two sizes).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197634/b29a9e0fcc7aa4459e9cb1ad4e6b5c93b525ae00.png

Pre-set the energy amounts to high. 
(The battery is 10 Ah. The small reactor has 500 Ah. The large reactor is 1000 Ah).
Tests will show the final amounts.

Reactors produce a lot of energy and take up little space. 
But after they are used up, they need to be demolished.
